name: Xvfb
tagline: This container needs special attention. Please check https://hub. Docker. Com/r/linuxserver/xvfb for details.
description: This container needs special attention. Please check https://hub.docker.com/r/linuxserver/xvfb for details.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/xvfb:debiantrixie-version-9d327c0f@sha256:db8c513160544109a1ed06256ea0fbdc8e40fc1f78e6096755f9c30bae8aa38a
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 80
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /srv/lsio/xvfb/config
        target: /config
